{{Quote|Sir, we're cut off. Thurson and Jeryl tried to get out, but Imperials are all over the swamps...|Terrorist|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Thurson''' was a member of the [[Eagle's network]] that was present at the [[Eagle's Nest]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] when the hideout was stormed by the forces of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Despite attempting to get out, Thurson was either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or [[Prisoner/Legends|apprehended]].
